request.system:
You are a helpful customer support assistant for Hawa Home, a smart home brand that sells the Hawa Aero ceiling fan, the Hawa Lock S1 smart door lock and the Hawa Pure RO water purifier.

Answer the customer's question. You can use the tools to control their devices.

The customer's devices:
- fan-living: Living room fan (Hawa Aero, room: living room)
- fan-bedroom: Bedroom fan (Hawa Aero, room: bedroom)
- lock-main: Main door lock (Hawa Lock S1, room: main door)
- purifier-kitchen: Kitchen purifier (Hawa Pure RO, room: kitchen)

Some manual sections that may help:
[general/service#tickets-and-visit-times] Service: Tickets and Visit Times
You can raise a service ticket in the Hawa Home app, by asking the Hawa assistant, or by calling
support. A ticket needs the device, a short description of the issue and a mobile number.
Ticket numbers look like HW-100001. A technician visits within 48 hours in metro cities and
within 72 hours in other cities. Visits under warranty are free. Out of warranty, the visit
charge is Rs 299 plus the cost of parts. Service hours are 9 AM to 9 PM, all 7 days.
Replacement: if a product has a manufacturing defect within 7 days of delivery, Hawa replaces it.

[general/warranty#coverage-periods] Warranty: Coverage Periods
Warranty starts from the date on the purchase invoice:
- Hawa Aero ceiling fan: 3 years on the whole fan, and 5 years on the BLDC motor.
- Hawa Lock S1: 2 years on electronics and 5 years on the mechanical lock body.
- Hawa Pure RO: 1 year on the purifier. Filters, the RO membrane and the UV lamp are
  consumables and are not covered by warranty.
Register your product in the Hawa Home app within 30 days of purchase to get 6 extra months of
warranty (one time per product). You can check your warranty with your product serial number,
for example HA-AERO-1001. The serial number is printed on the box and on a sticker on the product.

[general/warranty#what-voids-the-warranty] Warranty: What Voids the Warranty
The warranty does not cover, and becomes void in case of:
- Opening the fan motor housing, the sealed lock electronics, or the purifier's sealed parts.
- Installation or repair by anyone who is not a Hawa certified technician.
- Damage from voltage outside the rated range, lightning, fire, flood or accidents.
- Using non-genuine filters or spare parts.
- Physical damage, rust caused by misuse, or a removed or changed serial number sticker.
Normal wear of remote buttons and the cosmetic finish is not covered.

[lock/users#fingerprint-enrolment] Users: Fingerprint Enrolment
The first fingerprint you add becomes the Admin fingerprint. Only an admin can add or delete
other users.
Using the app: open Hawa Home > Lock S1 > Users > Add user > Fingerprint, then place the same
finger on the sensor 6 times, lifting it between each touch, until the app shows "Enrolled".
Using the keypad: press * then #, enter the admin PIN, press 1 (Add user) then 1 (Fingerprint),
and place the finger 6 times. The lock gives 2 short beeps when enrolment is successful.
Tips: enrol at least 2 fingers per person, keep fingers dry and clean, and enrol children's
fingers again every 6 months because fingerprints change as they grow.

messages.content: How much does a technician visit cost if my product is out of warranty, and how fast do they come?

tools.name: get_device_status
tools.description: Get the live status of one of the user's devices (online, speed, battery, filter life).

tools.name: set_fan_speed
tools.description: Set the speed of a Hawa Aero fan. Speed must be an integer from 1 to 5.

tools.name: check_warranty
tools.description: Check warranty status for a product serial number like HA-AERO-1001.

tools.name: create_service_ticket
tools.description: Raise a service ticket for a technician visit. Needs the device, a short issue description and the user's 10-digit Indian mobile number.

response.text:
If your product is out of warranty, the technician visit charge is **Rs 299** plus the cost of any required parts. 

As for how fast they arrive:
* **Metro cities:** Within 48 hours
* **Other cities:** Within 72 hours
